conclusion: Saved local connectivity, material interpolation and one foliage-pixel failure are reproduced. The diagnostic succeeds; it does not qualify the rejected reduction or establish collapse ancestry or full-population causality.
authorship_disclosure: Reviewer authored witness_material.py and five appended synthetic tests. Its executable source approval was provided by the separate reviewer. This outcome uses a separate stdlib/struct/math readback rather than calling the authored witness implementation.
verification_scope: Read saved private JSON facetables, selected existing NPY rows with an independent bounded struct reader, and two existing PNGs through Pillow. Recomputed local normal/area/incidence/multiplicity and one byte/F32-decode/F64-barycentric/IEC expression using standard math. No NumPy, sampler, simplifier, full quality suite, full raster or Blender was run for this review.
independent_readback_execution: Short exec_command process, not a separately supervised OwnedJob worker. No separate Job memory-cap or peak-memory claim is made for this tiny review. The owned execution measurements below refer only to the actual diagnostic stage.
limitations: Complete all-triangle hit/miss and global membership scans were not repeated; authenticated producer and saved buffers bind those statements.
No collapse ancestry exists. Local non-manifold endpoint association is not a population causal proof.
The colour point has no paired original-surface material evaluation; its full residual is not attributable solely to collapse.
One failed pixel is a pixel-centre diagnostic, not global foliage damage or a raster-bug claim.
The maximum incidence-nine pair worsens an existing incidence-four pair. The eight separately selected newly bad pairs are a small deterministic sample.
Three primary candidate face occurrences match original oriented triples; this is not a claim of three distinct original triangles.
The colour witness has a new source-ID triple, but no paired same-point original-surface material baseline. Its full residual is not proved collapse-caused.
The proposed small constraint-aware patch experiment is justified for separate approval; no replacement API, sheet/part construction, target reduction or full-model resource outcome is qualified.
